# SNV frequency and HMM state assignment

R notebook to perform statistical analysis on HMM state assignment and timing of fixation events to find donor-specific and segment-specific differences

## 0. General

### 0.1. Load libraries

```{r}
library(emmeans)
```

## 1. Timing of first fixation effect

```{r}
first_fixation <- read.csv("../results/timing_of_first_fixation_event_per_population.csv")
first_fixation$donor  <- factor(first_fixation$donor)
```

```{r}
fit <- glm(passage ~ donor, data = first_fixation, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
fit_null <- glm(passage ~ 1, data = first_fixation, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
anova_res <- anova(fit_null, fit, test = "F")
print(anova_res)
```

```{r}
#custom contrast to compare timing of donor 1 and 2 vs donor 3 and 4
em <- emmeans(fit, ~donor)
contrast_res <- contrast(em, list("1+2 vs 3+4" = c(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5)))
summary_contrast <- summary(contrast_res, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
print(summary_contrast)
```

```{r}
est <- summary_contrast$estimate
se <- summary_contrast$SE
t_val <- summary_contrast$t.ratio
p_val <- summary_contrast$p.value
df <- summary_contrast$df
ci_lower <- summary_contrast$lower.CL
ci_upper <- summary_contrast$upper.CL

cat(sprintf("Estimate (log scale) between 1+2 vs 3+4: %.3f, ratio: %.2f\n", est, exp(est)))
cat(sprintf("95%% CI for ratio: %.2f to %.2f\n", exp(ci_lower), exp(ci_upper)))
cat(sprintf("results t(%.0f) = %.2f, p = %.4f\n", df, t_val, p_val))
```

```{r}
#need to scheffe adjust 
df_model <- length(coef(fit)) - 1
f_crit <- qf(0.95, df_model, df)
scheffe_crit <- sqrt(df_model * f_crit)

ci_log_scheffe_l <- est - scheffe_crit * se
ci_log_scheffe_u <- est + scheffe_crit * se
p_scheffe <- pf(t_val^2 / df_model, df_model, df, lower.tail = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Scheffe-adjusted: t = %.2f, p = %.4f | 95%%-CI ratio: %.2f to %.2f\n", 
            t_val, p_scheffe, exp(ci_log_scheffe_l), exp(ci_log_scheffe_u)))
```

```{r}
#pairwise comparison
pairwise_res <- pairs(em, adjust = "holm")
pdf <- as.data.frame(pairwise_res)
pdf$sig <- pdf$p.value < 0.05

print(pdf)
```
